row.proto: uint64_t Ne_PooledList_SetCapacity_Node24(void *list, uint64_t newCap, int64_t maxCap)
row.notes: (lib) Pool-backed doubly linked list resize: growing allocates a 0x28 block header plus (delta*0x18) node slab and threads it onto the free list (+0x18); shrinking pops nodes, or rebuilds via a temp list and swap. Stores capacity at +0x38 and limit at +0x40. Returns 0 or errno 0xc (ENOMEM); also sets errno 0x16/1 on misuse.
